title: IngestAuditEntry
description: One row in the ingest audit log. Written BEFORE accepting an upload; if the write fails, the upload is rejected (INGEST_SECURITY §2 invariant 10). This is a separate, append-only log; the tamper-evident chain is SystemAuditEntry. Contract anchors: UX_FROZEN.md v1.3 §5.4 + INGEST_SECURITY.md v1.0 §2.

filename.description: Original filename as provided by the client, truncated to 255 chars. null for streamed / URL sources.

mimeDeclared.description: Content-Type sent by the client. NEVER trusted; used only for audit comparison.

mimeReal.description: libmagic / file-type verdict. The one that decided whitelist passage.

verdict.description: Final disposition. 'quarantined' means the artifact is held pending async re-scan; 'rejected' + AV-positive = immediate deletion from quarantine bucket.

quarantineUri.description: R2 URI in foco-quarantine bucket while scanning. Cleared after final disposition.
